satellite_audit.project_name: 4L of Jind-Gohana road Package-1 from km. 0.00 to km. 40.601 of NH-352 A under NHO

row_corridor.basis: 60 m statutory half-width for 'Roads & Highways', buffered about an image-derived centreline at 97.5 deg. The alignment is estimated from the dominant structure bearing, not surveyed.

epoch_index_calibration.reference: tightest-quartile brightness-matched pixels inside the analysed area, post-RRN

stability.identical_frame_basis: Null test over 50 scenes: the chain run on a frame against itself reports 0.000% transition on 50/50, so the rules are deterministic and self-consistent.
stability.resolution_artefact_basis: Same 50 scenes with a sigma=1.2 blur as the only difference report 1.38% total flow. That bounds how much of any observed transition is the 2023 basemap being softer rather than the ground being different.
stability.interpretation: Reverse flow exceeding forward is not attributable to classifier instability (0.00%) or to resolution (1.38pp of 13.36pp). It is a property of the imagery. No labelled material corpus exists for these tiles, so the thresholds have NOT been tuned until the forward figure wins -- that would assume the conclusion. Read the net figure with both directions visible.

material_transition.classifier: rule-based over {ExG, VARI, HSV saturation/value, local texture energy}
material_transition.caveat: Declared decision rules, not a trained model. No labelled material corpus exists for this imagery, so these are interpretable thresholds a reviewer can challenge individually -- not validated class accuracies.

construction_velocity.epoch_basis: Baseline is ESRI Wayback release 23448/10 (2014-02-20), verified against the provider's release index. The after-epoch is the live World Imagery mosaic as fetched on 2026-08-25; ESRI does not publish a per-tile capture date, so its vintage is bounded by the fetch date rather than known. The span is therefore an upper bound of 150.1 months, and any rate derived from it is a lower bound.

pace_vs_dpr.caveat: Progress pace uses the agency's REPORTED physical progress over the imagery window; the imagery contributes the independent area figure beside it, not this ratio. In this corpus surface change and reported progress correlate at r = +0.004 (Pearson, p = 0.87; Spearman rho = +0.024) across 1,588 site-level projects (artifacts/eo_progress_independence.json), so the two must be read together rather than substituted.

sar_readiness.reason: No Sentinel-1 GRD/SLC scenes are ingested in this deployment. The optical chain is the only evidence source currently live.
sar_readiness.planned_source: Sentinel-1 C-band (IW mode), Copernicus Open Access Hub
sar_readiness.why_it_matters: Optical change detection is unusable under monsoon cloud, which is precisely the season when schedule disputes arise. InSAR coherence decorrelates where the surface has been disturbed, so it reports activity through cloud.

reconnaissance_targets.basis: Connected-component clusters of the structural-change mask whose CENTROID lies at ROI weight >= 0.55 (inside the surveyed Right-of-Way) and whose area exceeds 40 px. 0 cluster(s) were rejected for falling outside the corridor and 0 for being below the area floor. Type and colour follow the material measured inside each cluster in the AFTER epoch, not the size of the change.

sovereign_verdict.headline: AUDIT ALERT: 0.0 m2 surface change found (Contractor claimed 100%).
sovereign_verdict.detail: No change cluster survives containment inside the surveyed Right-of-Way across the epoch window, while the executing agency reports substantial physical progress. Resolve by inspection: verify the geocode, the epoch dates and the works schedule before treating this as over-reporting.

construction_stage.rule_basis: reported progress 100% >= 20% with zero measured surface change over the epoch window
construction_stage.confidence_note: Softmax margin of the linear head, not a calibrated probability. The head's measured cross-validated accuracy is 38.3%; read that as the reliability of this phase, not the score above.

validation.protocol: 5-fold stratified cross-validation of a multinomial logistic head on 768-d Prithvi embeddings. The head sees ONLY the embedding — no measured EO feature is an input — so this measures whether the backbone reads construction stage off the pixels.
validation.labels: Distant supervision from the measured EO chain (see derive_stage_label). These are rules, NOT annotated ground truth: no labelled construction-stage corpus exists for these tiles. Accuracy here is agreement with a rule, not with reality.
validation.verdict: CONTRIBUTING. The Prithvi embedding recovers the stage at 38.3% against a 27.2% majority baseline and a 25.1% permutation ceiling, so the backbone is reading construction state from the imagery rather than the head memorising class frequencies.
